# Add clue constraints
for i in range(n):

        if clues[i][j] != -1:
            solver.add(cells[i][j] == clues[i][j])

# Domain: each cell in [0,9]

    for j in range(n):
        solver.add(cells[i][j] >= 0, cells[i][j] <= 9)

# Row constraints: all distinct in each row

    solver.add(Distinct([cells[i][j] for j in range(n)]))

# Column constraints: all distinct in each column

    solver.add(Distinct([cells[i][j] for i in range(n)]))

# Solve

    flat = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            flat.append(model.eval(cells[i][j]).as_long())
    print("SAT")
    print(flat)
